child-of-the-sun.summary: Touched by Eirdu's light: you and nearby allies shrug off blindness, and you can outline foes in Faerie Fire.

Eyes of Eirdu.summary: You and allies within 10 ft have Advantage on saves to avoid or end Blinded.

Faerie Fire.summary: Learn Faerie Fire, cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat); once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. Damage can't break Concentration on the free casting.

shadowmoor-hexer.summary: A Shadowmoor curse-weaver whose Hex bites back at those who strike them.

Hex.summary: Hex is always prepared, cast with INT, WIS or CHA (picked with the feat); once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots.

Curse Magic.summary: A creature under your Hex that hits you with an attack roll takes Psychic damage equal to your PB, at most once per turn.
